On my subverse I want to get rid of the Share link, and text button from the top bar, due to it being to big and an eyesore. I also want to change color of the text for new, top, hot buttons. Can someone please help? Thus is what it looks like currently https://voat.co/v/TheCreatureshub
[Request] Changing the top bar (new, top, hot).

I'm at work and can't confirm it before I give this to you... so let me know if it doesn't work for you... but I think it should work like this...

To make the share/discuss buttons disappear:

.tabmenu li.disabled a.contribute {
display: none;}

As far as the Hot/New/Top buttons, here is the code I am using, which includes drop shadows. Adjust the color values to what you like, and you can remove or adjust the webkit-box-shadow and box-shadow attributes if you want to:

.tabmenu li.selected a {
background: #000000; 
color: #FFFFFF; 
border-color: #D71920;
-webkit-box-shadow: 0px 0px 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0) inset;
box-shadow: 0px 0px 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0) inset;
border-radius: 0px;}

.tabmenu li.disabled a {
background: #FFFFFF; 
color: #000000; 
border-color: #D71920;
border-radius: 0px;
border-width: 2px;
-webkit-box-shadow: 2px 2px 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255) inset;
box-shadow: 2px 2px 2px 1px rgba(255,255,255) inset;}
